hooks.command: git pull --rebase --autostash --quiet 2>/dev/null; echo '--- last decisions ---'; tail -n 40 docs/DECISIONS.md

f=$(cat | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))'); case "$f" in *packages/contracts/*|*app/schemas.py*) echo 'CONTRACT FILE CHANGED: add a docs/DECISIONS.md entry, regenerate openapi.yaml and types.ts, prefix the commit with contract:' ;; esac
